headlines.title: NYT reports Nvidia CEO had second extramarital relationship
headlines.description: Questions are growing about Jensen Huang’s ability to hang on as CEO of Nvidia after the New York Times reported he had an extramarital relationship with an executive at the company who reported to him. NBC News’ Hallie Jackson reports.

headlines.title: Democrat wins Mississippi Senate race
headlines.description: NBC News is projecting Democrat Scott Colom has won the Senate race in Mississippi. NBC News’ Ryan Nobles reports.

headlines.title: White House warns congressional Democrats: Investigating us may be a crime
headlines.description: Rep. Robert Garcia, the incoming House Oversight Committee chair, noted that the Constitution grants Congress “latitude to conduct investigations.”

headlines.title: At least two people dead in Brooklyn partial building collapse
headlines.description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani and the NYC fire commissioner provided an update following a partial building collapse at the edge of a construction site in New York City, which killed two people and injured dozens. Law enforcement will lead an investigation to determine the cause.

headlines.title: She’s delivered 2,000 babies. The measles outbreak changed her mind about vaccines.
headlines.description: Traditional midwives like Roberta Devers could be key to increasing vaccination as outbreaks spread in rural communities such as those in Pennsylvania.

headlines.title: What are childhood vaccination rates in your community and schools?
headlines.description: This is part of The Vaccine Divide, an updated data investigation into America potentially losing its measles-free status as the deadly virus roars back and childhood vaccine defenses continue to crack and crumble.

headlines.title: Behind the data: How NBC News tracked the decline in childhood vaccinations
headlines.description: How an NBC News data investigation tracked vaccination and school exemption rates across thousands of counties in the U.S.

headlines.title: Measles cases explode amid declining vaccination rates
headlines.description: NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin traveled to Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, which is the epicenter of a deadly measles outbreak. The investigative report for the NBC News series “The Vaccine Divide” finds 75% of U.S. counties have vaccination rates that are now below the level needed for herd immunity.

headlines.title: As U.S. pushes back on data centers, China races to build them and catch up
headlines.description: As opposition against data centers mounts in the United States, that's not exactly what's happening in China. The country is beefing up its data center construction across Inner Mongolia and leaning into its manufacturing edge to catch up to the U.S. on AI. NBC News' Janis Mackey Frayer reports.

headlines.title: Sen. Richard Blumenthal ordered to preserve documents from inquiry into Trump ballroom
headlines.description: The official’s letter comes on the day the White House told congressional Democrats that investigations into the administration could be a crime.
